claims.sectionKey: 라도 introduce an alternative that is accepted as a minimum, concessive or sufficient within a set
claims.summary: The particle 라도 is used to introduce an alternative that is accepted as a minimum, concessive or sufficient within a set, depending on the context.
한 시간이라도 signals that one hour is a minimum acceptable amount of study time compared to larger alternatives.
커피라도 마실래요? uses 라도 to present coffee as an available alternative among other possible drinks or solutions.

claims.sectionKey: 한 시간이라도 공부하세요. 라도 takes scope over the amount and establishes a minimum acceptable
claims.summary: The particle 라도 takes scope over the amount and establishes a minimum acceptable level.

claims.sectionKey: 커피라도 마실래요? 라도 functions as an available alternative
claims.summary: In 커피라도 마실래요?, 라도 functions as an available alternative among other possible drinks or solutions.
